entries.logic: Creates a QPushButton with the project's standard blue style and consistent padding.
entries.implementation:
auto* btn = new QPushButton("Text", this);
btn->setStyleSheet("background-color: #4285F4; color: white; font-weight: bold; padding: 8px 15px; border-radius: 4px;");
entries.rationale: Maintains visual consistency across all panes of the Parcel IDE.

entries.logic: Configures a QTextEdit to look like a terminal/console with fixed-width font and dark background.
entries.rationale: Ensures technical output is readable and fits the SSQLM aesthetic.

entries.logic: Creates a QLabel styled as a section header with the signature cyan color.
entries.implementation:
auto* header = new QLabel("TITLE", this);
header->setStyleSheet("font-weight: bold; color: #00BFFF; font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 5px;");
entries.rationale: Standardizes the information hierarchy in the UI.
